values.note: Village rates effective November 1, 2025: electric or electric & water $40 a night, full hookup (sites 00-60) $45, full hookup (sites 100-140) $50; primitive $35 (left out of the base); cabins $80. Weekly $240-300, monthly $500-600. Extra person or vehicle $5. No resident/non-resident camping split (the $20 resident / $50 non-resident annual pass is for the boat launch). Full-hookup sites get 300 kWh a month, then $0.13/kWh (monthly stays). Campspot quoted the same $40-50 for 2026-10-20 (read 2026-10-13).

fees.source: https://www.shamrockpark.net/rates.htm ('Below rates are effective November 1, 2025': Primitive $35, Electric $40, Electric & Water $40, Full Hookup 00-60 sites $45, Full Hookup 100-140 sites $50) + https://www.shamrockpark.net/electricsurcharge.pdf, read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.shamrockpark.net/ ('All of our full hookup sites are choice of 30 or 50 amp electrical service'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 124 sites: full hookup (30/50 amp), water & electric, electric only and primitive, plus 3 riverbank cabins. Campspot lists RV site types to 45 ft (premium full hookup and pull-throughs); the cheapest electric sites take 30 ft.

sites.source: https://www.shamrockpark.net/ ('The campground now has a total of 124 sites'; 'Several are large, pull-thru sites') + https://www.campspot.com/book/shamrockpark-mi (site types' max lengths 30-45 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Restrooms and the fish-cleaning station are heated in winter. Dump station $10.

facilities.source: https://www.shamrockpark.net/ ('modern restrooms and showers, DNR built boat ramp, fish cleaning station, and sanitary dump station') + https://www.shamrockpark.net/ratesandpolicies.pdf ('Free WiFi Available'; 'Dump Station $10'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Year-round; many full-hookup sites stay open in winter (heated water service; skirting rules apply).

season.source: https://www.shamrockpark.net/ ('a year-round camping and fishing park'; 'Many of our full hookup sites are even open during the winter') + https://www.shamrockpark.net/wintercamping.htm, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online on Campspot or by phone; paid in full at booking. Next season's reservations open after January 1. Stays over 28 days are booked by phone. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before (72 for holidays). Cabins: 2-night minimum May-September. No permanent sites.

booking.source: https://www.shamrockpark.net/reservationonline.htm ('https://www.campspot.com/book/shamrockpark-mi'; 'Reservations exceeding 28 days are still made by calling the office at 269-473-5691') + https://www.shamrockpark.net/reservationinformation.htm ('We offer no permanent sites as we are a campground') + ratesandpolicies.pdf, read 2026-10-22

note: Village of Berrien Springs camping and fishing park on the bank of the St. Joseph River (9385 US 31), with a DNR boat ramp, a fish-cleaning station and charter fishing; the park manager lives on site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the village's own site (rates effective Nov 1, 2025): $40 electric to $50 full hookup (no resident split; primitive $35 left out), 30/50-amp full hookups, year-round, reservable on Campspot, dump. Added phone 269-473-5691 (entry had none), 124 sites, max 45 ft (Campspot), pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/Wi-Fi, booking notes. Note cleaned of the site-count text.
